Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
if :dtl_blk.test_id = 'ALT' then
begin
SELECT ALT_E_LEVEL, ALT_SE_LEVEL INTO :alt_e_level, :alt_se_level
 FROM CHAPTERS WHERE
 CHAPTER_ID = :global.chapter_id;
if (to_number(:result_code)) >= :alt_se_level
then
 :result_code := 'SE';
 :s_result_desc := 'Super-Elevated';
else
if (to_number(:result_code)) >= :alt_e_level
then
 :result_code := 'E';
 :s_result_desc := 'Elevated';
else
 :result_code := 'N';
 :s_result_desc := 'Negative/Nonreactive';
end if;
end if;
 exception when others then
 handle_error;
end;
else
 if :dtl_blk.test_id = 'CHOL' then
 if (to_number(:result_code)) > 0 then
 :result_code := 'TO';
 else
 :s_result_desc := 'invalid result code';
 end if;
else
begin
select substr(code_desc,1,20) into :s_result_desc from master_codes
 where code_type = 'RESUL' and
 code = :result_code;
exception when no_data_found then
 :s_result_desc := ' ';
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;
end if;
end if;

/* Added by HCL to calculate check digit */
:chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:dtl_blk.unit_id, null, null);

end;
